### `class DebugCommand` — `src/main/java/synthetic_diamonds/debug/DebugCommand.java`
Development-only: /synthetic_diamonds debug press [] looks up the live synthetic_diamonds:weighted_pressing recipe for item (charcoal, ROLL-REQ-004's "identical parameter" default, when omitted) through the same RecipeManager/AllRecipeTypes.PRESSING lookup a real MechanicalPressBlockEntity uses (synthetic_diamonds.recipe.WeightedPressingRecipe's own Javadoc; `docs/spec/domains/roll.md` ROLL-REQ-005), rolls WeightedPick#pick count times against that recipe's own weights using the level's RandomSource, and prints the tally — makes the exclusivity guarantee (ROLL-REQ-001) and the real-world odds directly observable without waiting through hundreds of real 240-tick press cycles (`docs/spec/operations/testing.md`'s "Development tool" row; SD-4).
- `void register()`
- `int press(CommandSourceStack source, int count, Item item)` — Looks up synthetic_diamonds:weighted_pressing's live recipe for item the same way WeightedPressingRecipe's own Javadoc documents MechanicalPressBlockEntity.getRecipe doing it — ServerLevel.recipeAccess() .getRecipeFor(AllRecipeTypes.PRESSING, ...) — then rolls WeightedPick#pick count times against that recipe's own (unnormalized) chance fields and reports the tally.
